meta.label: baseline-b99cf52
meta.xvfb_args: Xvfb :N -screen 0 1920x1080x24 -ac -nolisten tcp -noreset (no window manager, no compositor; a new server for every measured launch)

chromium.name: Chromium (Playwright build, headed, full browser UI)
chromium.note: Playwright's Chromium build, NOT branded Google Chrome: no Google services, no sync, no API keys, no proprietary codecs/DRM. The same Blink/V8/Skia core and the same browser UI code.

sweef.name: Sweef desktop GUI (`sweef gui`, native X11 window)
sweef.note: built from head at b99cf52, -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w'; profile pre-seeded with onboarding.done=true

chromium.note: the whole Playwright Chromium install directory (chrome, resources, locales, helpers); shared system libraries are not counted for either browser

sweef.note: the single sweef binary (fonts, chrome UI, engine are embedded); shared system libraries (libc only) are not counted

env_notes.priority: nice -10 for the harness, Xvfb and both browsers
env_notes.proxy: browsers reach the network through a recording CONNECT proxy in front of the sandbox egress proxy; loopback is not proxied by either browser
